rationale: The displayed Lean conclusions faithfully reproduce Lemma 4.1 under k=m+1. The proposition as a whole does not. It assumes the weighted residual estimates that the paper derives from the floating-point execution, so it cannot by itself recover the paper theorem. Conversely, it ranges over abstract non-paper formats, so the selected paper result does not cover every Lean run.
